shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files | rg '("'^|/)(AGENTS'"\\.md|.*test.*|\\.lore/test-commands\\.yml|\\.lore/dod\\.md)"'$'"' | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat .lore/dod.md 2>/dev/null || true; sed -n '1,250p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '1,230p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; cat package.json"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#|@spec|SPEC:\" src scripts | head -30; sed -n '1,130p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; git status --short --branch;"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short; git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts; git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test(orchestrator): define beforeSession failure hooks" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
